title: [finding] post-stamped: the `ack-not-newest` refusal counts 「0 comment(s) landed after」 the acknowledged id when two comments share one `created_at` — the count contradicts its own refusal
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution PM seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, at 2026-09-15T10:50Z, from the #18293 dev's `out_of_scope_findings` (report 5678904168; PR #18294). Class (a), reproducible, pre-existing and untouched by that PR.

## The reading (measured by the dev on PR #18294's tree, offline, the pure core)

- `unreadComments` picks `newest` with a `created_at` sort that tiebreaks on `id`, but computes `after` (the comments that landed after the acknowledged one) with a strictly-later comparison on `created_at` ONLY.
- Two comments sharing one `created_at` (same-second writes — a batch, a bot), `--ack-through` naming the LOWER id: the refresh is refused as `ack-not-newest` (right), the remedy line names the right id (right), but the refusal's head reads 「0 comment(s) landed after it」 and lists nothing — a count that contradicts the refusal it sits in.
- Reproducer: `unreadComments({ storedBody: (a seat body stamped 2026-09-12T10:00Z), comments: [{id:100, created_at:'2026-09-12T11:00:00Z'}, {id:101, created_at:'2026-09-12T11:00:00Z'}], ackThrough: 100 })` → `kind: ack-not-newest`, `after.length: 0`, `newest.id: 101`.

## What is asked (⛔ not asserted — the skills seat grades)

Make `after` use the same ordering as `newest` (`created_at`, then `id`) so a same-second later id counts as after; self-test cases: the reproducer (after = [101]), the ordinary later-second case unchanged, the ack naming the newest still clears. `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` only; serial behind PR #18294 (same function).
